summary: Plus is in good shape: every tool Rachelle listed exists and runs on live data, and the six “Tier 1 — fix immediately” bugs from her spec are all fixed. The gaps are mostly small rule details (a few thresholds and scoring weights differ from her numbers), three missing extras on Flow Radar, the AI-written sentences (no AI layer is connected yet), and two places where we followed her later mockup instead of the written spec (Spot Pulse and Intelligence no longer have their own tabs).

Pro is about half built against her four Pro briefs. The visible structure is there — Flow Balance panel, cross-signal outlines, the three-section Watchlist, the wallet lookup page — but the “smart” layers are not: the per-asset significance engine, the six ◆ early-signal tags, saved lists, wallet rows, signal history, the full alert system, and most of the Crypto Address Tracker's analysis (PnL, win rate, AI read, behaviour flags, linked wallets). Since 10 Oct, Flow Radar Pro, Watchlist Pro and Spot Pulse Pro are separate Pro tools, Watchlist Pro uses Rachelle's 7-day rule, and Spot Pulse Pro has its 10 tiles.

A handful of items are blocked only by the CoinGlass plan (STARTUP). Upgrading would unlock Pro Spot Pulse's second row, the liquidation-zone tags, large-order events and the single-call coin data the spec assumes.

priorities.title: Deploy the Firestore rules fix (security)
priorities.why: Right now any signed-in user can make themselves Pro or even superadmin from the browser console, and read Pro content without paying. The fix is written and tested on dev; it needs your go to deploy (it likely affects production too).

priorities.title: Fix the Console regime scoring to match the spec
priorities.why: Five small rule differences (extreme Fear & Greed weighted ±1.5, the ±$100M ETF band, the funding neutral zone, the OI-vs-price matrix, confidence measured on active signals only, and HYPE's 0.7 confidence cap). The Console verdict is the first thing every Plus user reads, and right now it can disagree with what Rachelle's rules would say.

priorities.title: Flow Radar: correct liquidation direction and smart-money severity
priorities.why: Every liquidation spike is currently labelled “Sell Pressure”, even short squeezes (which the spec says are bullish/green). Smart-money events never reach HIGH. Both are small rule fixes using data we already fetch.

priorities.title: Add the On-Chain asset HYPE (replace AVAX) and the missing OI / funding bands
priorities.why: On-Chain Insights is the only Plus page whose asset switcher doesn't match the BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/HYPE universe used everywhere else.

priorities.title: Decide the open questions (see “Decisions needed”)
priorities.why: Plus Flow Radar delay, Spot Pulse/Intelligence tabs, Console preview panels, the Watchlist Signal column, and the three removed Pro tabs. Each one changes what gets built next.

priorities.title: Build the Exchange Flow event type and turn on cross-signal outlines for Plus
priorities.why: The endpoint is available on our plan; Plus Flow Radar currently shows a “Netflow Flip” event in its place (which the spec reserves for Pro). Cross-signal outlines already work for Pro — the Plus spec wants them too.

priorities.title: Connect an AI layer for the written interpretations
priorities.why: Console regime sentence, Flow Radar verdict paragraph, Spot Pulse sentence and Fear & Greed News Tone all specify an LLM (with template fallback). None is connected; a GEMINI_API_KEY already exists in the environment.

priorities.title: Flow Radar Pro significance engine
priorities.why: The single biggest Pro differentiator in the spec (“$10M is routine for BTC but huge for HYPE”). Needs a daily background job for per-asset baselines — the repo has no scheduled jobs yet, so this is the first one.

priorities.title: Watchlist Pro: add-time validation, ◆ early-signal tags, saved lists
priorities.why: Validation stops users adding illiquid coins (spec: spot + futures + $10M volume). The ◆ tags are the Pro-only value of the Watchlist; Liquidity Vacuum's order-book data is available on our plan.

priorities.title: Crypto Address Tracker: PnL, win rate, Trader/Farmer tags, multi-chain
priorities.why: Today it reads Ethereum mainnet only and shows “—” for PnL and win rate. These need trade-history reconstruction and explorer APIs (Etherscan-family, Solscan), which are free tiers.
